turns.text: Hello, I want to return a print and get the money back. I ordered the wrong size.
Could you send your order number and the email address you used to place the order? I’ll check whether the print can be returned for a refund.
The order is SC-3744 and the email is claire.fontaine@example.com.
Your return and refund for order SC-3744 need staff review. I’ve passed this to a colleague, who will take over and let you know the next steps. No refund has been approved yet.

rule.ro: Printurile din catalog se pot returna în 14 zile de la livrare. Clientul plătește transportul retur. Rambursarea trebuie aprobată de echipă.
rule.en: Catalogue prints can be returned within 14 days of delivery. The customer pays the return postage. Staff must approve the refund.

input.summary: Verified customer (claire.fontaine@example.com) wants to return a print ordered in the wrong size for a refund. Return policy check flagged large_refund; please review eligibility and advise on next steps. No request filed.
